package.name: nav_common_cmake
package.description:
Shared CMake helpers for the workspace. Currently only FindPCLUnified, which unifies how packages find PCL so that multiple PCL copies on one machine (the system one and the ROS one) cannot be picked by different packages and clash on symbols.
Packages used to include ../common/cmake by relative path, which silently fell back to find_package(PCL) on a different machine or after moving a directory level, leaving each package to pick its own. As a proper package it is located by find_package(nav_common_cmake), independent of directory layout.
